final: WITH s AS (SELECT si.healtheval AS status, SUM(sc.scancount) AS total_scancount, AVG(sc.gbsize * 1.0 / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS avg_gb_per_min FROM scans sc JOIN sites si ON si.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref WHERE sc.chronotag >= '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND sc.chronotag <= '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' GROUP BY si.healtheval), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_gb_per_min) AS mean_avg FROM s) SELECT s.status, s.total_scancount, s.avg_gb_per_min, s.avg_gb_per_min - m.mean_avg AS gap_from_mean FROM s, m WHERE m.mean_avg IS NOT NULL
